text:
maya: ap-southeast canary failed during promotion — pods are in ImagePullBackOff. deploy-bot flagged a digest mismatch between eu-west and ap-southeast registries. Anyone on-call for registry/mirroring?

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] release=payments-api chart=payments v=1.12.3 -> region=ap-southeast
  event=pod_failed_pull
  expected_digest=sha256:ef01c9...
  seen_digest=sha256:abcd123...
  reason=BlobUnknown

simon: sounds like the mirror didn't finish. pinging infra-registry team. Could be transient but we should avoid rolling back app-level changes if possible. :eyes:

registry-bot: mirror-status ap-southeast: job=mirror-payments-api last_attempt=2026-03-21T10:12:02Z status=503_retrying synced_objects=412/416 ETA=4m

maya: proposal: hold further regional promotions for 30m and apply a manual chart/image pin in ap-southeast to the previous known-good digest to keep prod stable. If mirror finishes, re-promote with digest verification. Agree?

jen: +1 to hold. To pin we can patch Helm values to set image.digest to the prior sha256 and force a rolling update. That avoids scaling down services. Example patch: 

```
helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace payments \
  --set image.tag=1.12.2 \
  --set image.digest=sha256:abcd123... \
  --reuse-values --timeout 5m
```

Also add a short release-note entry noting "regional promotion delayed — mirror lag" so customers in APAC aren't surprised.

simon: can we also add a guard so deploy-bot doesn't auto-retry promotions to ap-southeast while we hold? otherwise it'll keep retrying.

maya: added manual exception in deploy config: `deploybot.canary_exclude = ["ap-southeast"]` for this promotion. deploy-bot should respect it. I'll push a one-line change to the promotion job.

tk: oncall ack, opening INC-2026-034 for the mirror failure and cross-region promotion hold. I'll coordinate with registry infra. Can someone paste rollback commands for app teams if we decide to undo the canary?

jen: rollback/undo snippet: 

```
# rollback helm release to previous revision
kubectl -n payments rollout status deploy/payments
helm rollback payments 3 --namespace payments
# or force image to known-good digest
kubectl -n payments set image deployment/payments payments=registry.redwood:1.12.2@sha256:abcd123...
```

Also smoke checks after patch: `curl -fS https://payments-ap-southeast.internal/health || exit 1`

deploy-bot: promotion paused per config change. No further retries to ap-southeast will be attempted until manual re-enable.

registry-bot: mirror job recovered, synced_objects=416/416, last_sync=2026-03-21T10:18:31Z, integrity_check=pass

maya: we'll wait 10m after full sync then re-run promotion with digest verify step. Simon, can you own the re-promote once registry confirms equality? Steps: (1) confirm digest parity across regions, (2) remove canary_exclude for ap-southeast, (3) re-run deploy-bot promote with explicit digest check, (4) run smoke tests.

simon: I got it. Quick checklist I'll run after sync:
  1) `skopeo inspect docker://registry.eu-west/payments:1.12.3` -> sha256:ef01c9...
  2) `skopeo inspect docker://registry.ap-southeast/payments:1.12.3` -> sha256:ef01c9...
  3) remove exclude and re-promote: `deployctl promote --release payments --chart payments --version 1.12.3 --verify-digest`
  4) smoke tests & rollback window open for 15m.

jen: thanks. I'll update the release notes: "Regional promotion for payments v1.12.3 delayed for ap-southeast due to temporary registry mirror lag; pinned to previous digest in ap-southeast to maintain availability. Re-promotion pending mirror completion (INC-2026-034)."

maya: closing this hold in thread: hold applied, manual pin in place, incident opened, re-promote owner assigned. I'll post a final update when re-promotion finishes. :white_check_mark:
